title: Slow in & Slow out
description: Hai chấm cùng đi 240 px: một chấm đều tốc trông máy móc, chấm kia tăng giảm tốc trông tự nhiên.

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio slowinout, written here): Two dots cross 240 px together: top linear, bottom power2.inOut (easeInOutCubic) — recipe 1200 ms, site demo 1300 ms; 11 ticks under each track show the spacing (bunched at the ends for the eased one). Rule: entrance ease-out, exit ease-in, on-screen move ease-in-out. Params: duration (1.2 s) · distance (240 px) · ease (power2.inOut). Rule: entrances ease out, exits ease in, moves on screen ease in and out. The ticks show where the dot is at 11 equal steps of time.
